statement: Pinned rnconrad device-side emulator opens eeprom.bin directly inside guest EEPROM read/write handling and writes requested bytes to the file on write commands. This is legacy emulator persistence policy only and is not appropriate proof that a real Remote or virtualgamepad should persist each host write.

applicability.revision: Historical software emulator; physical hardware variant not established
applicability.scope: Source lines 226-315; compatibility design evidence relevant to #162 ephemeral-copy vs explicit export distinction.
